changes: Adapted the existing vectorizer.ai SVG trace by separating existing arm, leg, eye and mouth shapes; applying joint rotation, body squash, blinking, facial compression, mirroring and vertical jump displacement; rendering nine animation states in a transparent 57-frame WebP atlas. Source-native vector geometry was used, not AI-generated replacement artwork.
